card.name: Just before a named effect
card.fires_on: Small words (the, of, an, opening quote) right before a named phenomenon or effect, such as heat island effect, Pygmalion effect, paradoxical effect, or Sunyaev-Zel'dovich. The next word is expected to be a named effect or reaction.

modes.label: Linking word before an effect name
modes.description: A word like the, of, an or an opening quote after 'called', 'known as' or 'due to', leading into a named effect.

modes.label: Start of the word effect
modes.description: The letter o closing the word efecto in a Spanish passage.
modes.example: ofílicas, efect<<o>> de nevada, cambios repentinos

card.writes: It pushes toward words like phenomenon, phenomena and alias, which fit a named effect or phenomenon.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before a named effect, like 'the paradoxical effect' or 'heat island effect'.
